normalSyntheticFixture.sourceProvenance: Deterministic synthetic stereo tones, decaying kicks and silence. Intentional single-sample overloads are disabled. No recorded music or live input.
normalSyntheticFixture.steadyTimerIntervalLimit: Excludes startup through 0.4 s and the interval immediately following a capture or layout change; still a GUI-thread fixture, not DAW performance.
normalSyntheticFixture.captureMethod: Real JUCE editor component snapshots at 1x logical size; validates raster waveform and UI. The Studio OpenGL child is not captured by this method.
normalSyntheticFixture.timingLimit: Developer GUI-thread feed and PNG captures affect timer intervals; these are QA observations, not real-time audio or DAW performance measurements.
normalSyntheticFixture.deliveryClock: Prefill + floor(monotonic elapsed seconds * 48000), completed exactly in blocks of at most 800 samples until the explicit input stop.

explicitImpulseFixture.sourceProvenance: Deterministic synthetic stereo tones, decaying kicks and silence, with intentional +1.08 left / -1.04 right single-sample overloads enabled by --impulses. No recorded music or live input.
explicitImpulseFixture.steadyTimerIntervalLimit: Excludes startup through 0.4 s and the interval immediately following a capture or layout change; still a GUI-thread fixture, not DAW performance.
explicitImpulseFixture.captureMethod: Real JUCE editor component snapshots at 1x logical size; validates raster waveform and UI. The Studio OpenGL child is not captured by this method.
explicitImpulseFixture.timingLimit: Developer GUI-thread feed and PNG captures affect timer intervals; these are QA observations, not real-time audio or DAW performance measurements.
explicitImpulseFixture.deliveryClock: Prefill + floor(monotonic elapsed seconds * 48000), completed exactly in blocks of at most 800 samples until the explicit input stop.

limits: Synthetic PCM and raster editor tests on Apple M2 Max. Real Ableton playback and sustained DAW frame rate remain unverified.
